water.name: Water
water.blurb: Cistern loads from Sarn's Rest. Ordinary, and therefore precious. The road drinks it.

speargrain.name: Speargrain
speargrain.blurb: Veythar staple. Hard cereal that cuts the hands that reap it. The silo is the politics.

brineglass.name: Brineglass
brineglass.blurb: Fired kiln ware from Kharûn. The rock stays home; the skin of the industry travels.

witching_rods.name: Witching rods
witching_rods.blurb: Forest-cut shafts for finding and working water. The wood and the knowing stay in Zamath.

highweave.name: Highweave
highweave.blurb: Thalor mountain fibre worked into formal cloth. Dignity the high city can still put on a wagon.

oath_wine.name: Oath-wine
oath_wine.blurb: Spring-bitters of the Stronghold. Drunk when debts, seals, and second chances are made formal.
